label: For "Healthcare Shift Incentive Optimization": Recommend the minimum effective incentive or mix of incentives needed to fill hard-to-staff shifts without exceeding labour budgets or breaching pay and fairness policy. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Treating raw acceptance as incentive effect.
